purpose: Act before a state changes, or describe change occurring during an activity.
keywords: talk about time sequence duration habits
Plain form + うちに; noun + の / な-adjective + な + うちに
Please eat it while it is still warm.
I want to go to Kyoto while I am in Japan.
As I listened repeatedly, I learned the song.
Use an opportunity before it changes or act within an interval
うちに · before the opportunity changes
formation: Plain form + うちに; noun + の / な-adjective + な + うちに
restrictions: With an opportunity, the state must still hold; with ongoing activity, change may happen unnoticed.
mistake: Use 間 for a simple duration; うちに often highlights a changing opportunity or result.
